faq.q: How is a titanium double ferrule front sleeve manufactured?
faq.a: A typical titanium double ferrule front sleeve is manufactured using Precision CNC turning; Electropolishing; Class 100 cleanroom cleaning; Helium leak testing. BOZE CNC Ti uses precision CNC equipment with strict process controls to ensure consistent quality and dimensional accuracy.

faq.q: What are the alternatives to Grade 2 CP-Ti (UHP Melt) for titanium double ferrule front sleeve?
